DEDR1799 gives Gadaba (S.2) kure root/tuber and Parji kurḍa. The Ollari Gadaba survey kure root is an exact lexical match to the Gadaba comparator, but the primary lect label is S.2 rather than Ollari; this is an explicitly comparative extension across varieties.

DEDR2002 gives Gadaba kendī/kendiṭ hair (S./S.3), alongside feather senses in other varieties. Survey Ollari cendi hair is proposed comparatively with initial palatal c versus k and final-vowel notation preserved; the article does not itself print the Ollari form.

DEDR474 gives Ollari Gadaba inḍi two things and adjectival ir, with Parji irḍu two things. Survey Ollari iruḍu is a comparative variant of this numeral family, particularly close to Parji irḍu; preserve the survey’s language label and medial vowel rather than claiming an exact printed Ollari attestation.
